characteristic_features: circulating Sézary cells (clonal CD4+ T cells)

biomarkers.name: Circulating Sézary cells (CD4+/CD7- or CD4+/CD26- by flow, ≥1000/μL)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic threshold; distinguishes Sézary from erythrodermic MF

biomarkers.name: Clonal TCR rearrangement in blood + skin
biomarkers.clinical_use: Identical clone in blood and skin supports Sézary syndrome

biomarkers.name: CCR4
biomarkers.clinical_use: Target for mogamulizumab in relapsed/refractory disease (MAVORIC)

biomarkers.name: CD30
biomarkers.clinical_use: Brentuximab vedotin may be considered if CD30+

biomarkers.name: Extracorporeal photopheresis (ECP) response
biomarkers.clinical_use: Long-standing treatment modality for Sézary; often combined with IFN or bexarotene

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Circulating cerebriform (convoluted) T cells (Sézary cells) with erythroderma; lymph node infiltration and skin involvement
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Advanced-stage CTCL by definition (typically stage IVA1-IVA2)

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Leukaemic variant of CTCL with distinct blood biology; CCR4-directed mogamulizumab is an approved therapy for relapsed/refractory disease (MAVORIC)
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Erythroderma (diffuse skin involvement) with pruritus; circulating Sézary cells; lymphadenopathy

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Central memory CD4+ T cells (distinct from MF which is more often linked to skin-resident effector memory T cells) with skin tropism
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Mesoderm — lymphoid (central memory CD4+ T cells)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Central memory T cell phenotype (CD3+, CD4+, CD8-, CD27+, CD45RA-, CD62L+, CCR7 variable, CCR4+) — recirculating central memory phenotype distinct from skin-resident effector memory MF phenotype; characteristic cerebriform (convoluted) nuclei
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Central memory T-cell origin explains distinctive leukaemic biology (recirculating cells rather than skin-resident); CCR4 expression enables mogamulizumab activity (MAVORIC); represents different cell of origin than MF despite overlapping morphology
